## octodns (example.com.yaml, application/yaml;charset=utf-8, 36 written)
# example.com as an octoDNS zone (example.com.yaml), written by DomainScope from bind (cloudflare).
# Keys are in octoDNS order; the SOA, the apex NS and what octoDNS cannot hold are left out (see the notes).
# TXT values write ; as \; : load this file with escaped_semicolons: true on the YamlProvider (octoDNS refuses them with false, its default from 2.0).
---
'':
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        auto-ttl: true
        proxied: true
    ttl: 300
    type: A
    value: '192.0.2.10'
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        auto-ttl: true
    ttl: 300
    type: CAA
    values:
      - flags: 0
        tag: issue
        value: letsencrypt.org
      - flags: 0
        tag: iodef
        value: 'mailto:security@example.com'
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        auto-ttl: true
    ttl: 300
    type: MX
    values:
      - exchange: mail.example.com.
        preference: 10
      - exchange: mx2.example.net.
        preference: 20
  - octodns:
      cloudflare:
        auto-ttl: true
    ttl: 300
    type: TXT
    values:
      - 'v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.25 ip4:192.0.2.8/29 include:_spf.example.net ~all'
      - 'google-site-verification=AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz0123456789'
'*.apps':
  octodns:
    cloudflare:
      auto-ttl: true
      proxied: true
  ttl: 300
  type: A
  value: '192.0.2.20'
_autodiscover._tcp:

  ttl: 300
  type: SRV

    port: 443

    weight: 0

## dnscontrol (dnsconfig.js, text/javascript;charset=utf-8, 36 written)
// example.com as DNSControl's dnsconfig.js, written by DomainScope from bind (cloudflare).
// Read the notes DomainScope listed, then run `dnscontrol preview` before `dnscontrol push`.
var REG_NONE = NewRegistrar("none");
var DSP_MAIN = NewDnsProvider("main"); // the name of your provider's entry in creds.json

D("example.com", REG_NONE, DnsProvider(DSP_MAIN),
    DefaultTTL(300),
    A("@", "192.0.2.10", CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("www", "192.0.2.10", CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("api", "192.0.2.14", CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("admin", "192.0.2.12"),
    A("ftp", "192.0.2.10"),
    A("*.apps", "192.0.2.20", CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("mail", "198.51.100.25"),
    A("vpn", "203.0.113.5"),
    A("intranet", "10.20.30.40"),
    A("mixed", "192.0.2.30", CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("mixed", "192.0.2.31"),
    A("tagged", "192.0.2.40", CF_PROXY_ON),
    A("legacy.shop", "192.0.2.50"),
    A("old.dev", "192.0.2.60"),
    AAAA("www", "2001:db8::10", CF_PROXY_ON),
    AAAA("v6only", "2001:db8::77"),
    CAA("@", "issue", "letsencrypt.org"),
